promoted_candidates.name: Biofilm-Resistant Living-Surface (NO-secreting endothelial monolayer)
promoted_candidates.mechanism: Engineered endothelial-cell monolayer on catheter surface that continuously secretes nitric oxide (NO), creating a bacteriostatic microenvironment that prevents biofilm formation.
promoted_candidates.falsifiable_criterion: NO secretion rate >= 1 pmol/cm²/s (published threshold for bacteriostasis) sustained for >= 30 days in CSF-like conditions
promoted_candidates.first_action_R313: In vitro measurement of NO secretion rate from engineered endothelial cells
promoted_candidates.economic_mechanism: Reduces infection rate from 8-12% to <2% -> saves $40-80K per avoided infection

promoted_candidates.name: Distributed Micro-Shunt Mesh Swarm
promoted_candidates.mechanism: Distributed network of N micro-shunts, each with local pressure-feedback control (no central coordinator). Swarm intelligence: each micro-shunt adjusts its own conductance based on local pressure, emergent global drainage balancing.
promoted_candidates.falsifiable_criterion: N=10 distributed micro-shunts achieve >= 90% drainage capacity under 70% obstruction (any 7 of 10 obstructed), vs single-segment baseline < 30%
promoted_candidates.first_action_R313: Simulate N=10 distributed micro-shunts with local pressure-feedback control law
promoted_candidates.economic_mechanism: No single point of failure -> lower revision rate -> $35-50K savings per avoided revision
promoted_candidates.control_law_novelty: Distributed/local vs P-01's centralized. Genuine control-law differentiation.
